references.text: The prophecy in Isaiah describes the suffering and humiliation the Messiah will undergo, which mirrors Jesus' prediction of his own suffering and death.
The psalm predicts betrayal and suffering, paralleling Jesus' prediction of his being handed over to the leaders and his death.
Matthew gives a parallel account of Jesus' prediction of his suffering, death, and being handed over to the Gentiles.
Luke also gives a parallel account of Jesus' prediction of his suffering, death, and being handed over.
John describes Jesus' prediction of his exaltation (crucifixion), which indicates his being handed over and his death.
